steps.label: Predictions
steps.python:
VAL = {'baseline': (12, 10, 18, 110), 'logistic': (21, 12, 9, 108), 'tree': (24, 17, 6, 103)}   # (TP, FP, FN, TN) on 150 validation customers
def metrics(tp, fp, fn, tn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp)
    r = tp / (tp + fn)
    return {'accuracy': (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn), 'precision': p, 'recall': r, 'f1': 2 * p * r / (p + r)}
tp, fp, fn, tn = VAL['logistic']
print('flagged:', tp + fp, ' real churners among them:', tp)
# prints: flagged: 33  real churners among them: 21

steps.label: Accuracy
steps.python:
VAL = {'baseline': (12, 10, 18, 110), 'logistic': (21, 12, 9, 108), 'tree': (24, 17, 6, 103)}   # (TP, FP, FN, TN) on 150 validation customers
def metrics(tp, fp, fn, tn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp)
    r = tp / (tp + fn)
    return {'accuracy': (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn), 'precision': p, 'recall': r, 'f1': 2 * p * r / (p + r)}
m = metrics(*VAL['logistic'])
print('accuracy:', round(m['accuracy'], 3))
# prints: accuracy: 0.86
